name: sameem-hub-production
description: Sameem Hub — Netlify monorepo. Next.js landing + frozen v1.7 dashboard at /classic + Express/Prisma sync API at /api.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.netlify:build: npm --prefix backend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend run build
